ownerStatement: Phase 4.3a A2 — OWNER ACCEPTED. Record the Owner acceptance for A2 using the existing accepted governance/lifecycle mechanisms only.
scope: Phase 4.3a A2, the offline shadow-capture evaluator, exactly as merged at that commit and tree: sinbad-ai-core/shadow/capture-evaluator.js, tools/evaluate-shadow-capture.js, tests/sinbad-shadow-evaluator.test.js, docs/project2/PHASE_4_3A_A2_SHADOW_EVALUATOR.md. It reads captured sinbad-answer responses from a local directory outside the repository, maps them (A1 mapper), adapts them (Draft Adapter v0), gates them (Offline Chain v0), scores them (v1.0.1 detectors, v1.0.2 delivery ungated versus gated, v1.0.3 content safety) and writes one privacy-safe aggregate report; the capture record format sinbad-shadow-capture-record/0-v1 that a later capture client must write. Built as SINBAD TASK-5 through the accepted Participation Gate. Also accepted: the lifecycle evidence recorded for TASK-5 (PR linked, merge verified, post-merge CI verified, COMPLETED), which was recorded forward, not retroactively.

evidence.testReconciliation: local npm test 2497 tests = 2494 pass + 2 fail (known local-only CRLF hash tests) + 1 skipped (Docker unavailable); CI run 36855404802: 2497 tests, 2469 pass, 0 fail, 28 skipped

ledger.note: The ledger lives outside the repository; these hashes identify the events so the record can be checked against it. The pre-merge CI run is documented here, not in the ledger, because the lifecycle capability models post-merge CI only.
